facts.activity_file: removing isolation and returning to operations

control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report - kinetic exposure at P-3220

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-3220 and PT-3220 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. P-3220 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 22 March 2012 a hazard report was recorded on P-3220 and PT-3220 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
